title: Graphic Designer
summary: Graphic designers make the visuals a brand uses: social posts, ads, logos, brochures and packaging. They work in a brand's in-house studio or a design agency, taking briefs from marketing and handing finished files to printers or digital teams.
dailyDuties: Design social media and campaign creatives from briefs
Retouch and prepare images for ads and listings
Draw logos, icons and illustrations to brand guidelines
Lay out brochures, menus and reports
Prepare print-ready files and check proofs with printers
Present concepts and revise from feedback

skills.expectation: Use layout, typography, colour and visual hierarchy to make clear designs
Edit, retouch and composite images in Photoshop
Draw vector logos, icons and illustrations in Illustrator
Lay out brochures, reports and other multi-page documents in InDesign
Design within a brand's visual identity and help build its guidelines
Make social media and campaign creatives in the right sizes and formats
Prepare print-ready files with correct bleed, colour mode and resolution, and check proofs
Take briefs, present concepts and act on feedback
Make web banners and hand assets to product designers in Figma
Animate simple creatives and logo reveals in After Effects
Edit short videos for Reels and Shorts
Design simple web pages and app screens with the product team
Work with marketing teams, agencies and printers to deadlines
